title: Regular bipartite supergraph of a bipartite graph
statement: Let $G$ be a finite bipartite simple graph, and let $\Delta$ denote its maximum degree. Then there is a finite bipartite simple graph $H$ that is $\Delta$-regular (every vertex of $H$ has degree exactly $\Delta$) together with an embedding of $G$ into $H$ — an injection $V(G) \to V(H)$ under which two vertices of $G$ are adjacent if and only if their images are adjacent in $H$. In other words, every finite bipartite graph is (isomorphic to) an induced subgraph of a bipartite graph regular of degree equal to $\Delta$.
